stories.title: El PSOE y Frente Amplio exploran una alianza insólita en el Senado y se citan el domingo para negociar

en.title: PSOE and Broad Front explore unusual Senate alliance and meet Sunday to negotiate
en.summary: Spain's PSOE and Broad Front political parties are exploring a joint alliance for Senate representation, with negotiations scheduled for Sunday and a Friday deadline for finalizing any agreement.

stories.title: Trump sanciona al Tribunal Penal Internacional después del Nobel a Navi Pillay, una de sus exjuezas

en.title: Trump administration sanctions International Criminal Court after Nobel Peace Prize awarded to former judge Navi Pillay
en.summary: The Trump administration has imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court, announced by Secretary of State Marco Rubio hours after the court's former judge Navi Pillay received the Nobel Peace Prize. The U.S. government has long criticized the tribunal's handling of cases involving Israel.

stories.title: El Banco de España advierte que habrá que esperar hasta más allá de 2028 para ver una mejora de la oferta de vivienda

en.title: Bank of Spain warns housing supply will not improve until after 2028
en.summary: Spain's central bank indicates that improvements in housing supply will take years to materialize, with the director of its economics department noting evaluation of housing regulation decrees will occur only after their approval and sufficient data becomes available.

stories.title: El PSOE explora una lista unitaria de izquierdas en el Senado para arrebatar su control al PP

en.title: PSOE explores unified left-wing Senate slate to wrest control from PP
en.summary: The PSOE is investigating the possibility of running a joint Senate ticket with other leftist parties to prevent the PP from maintaining its majority, amid poll predictions of a rightist majority in Congress.

stories.title: Llega a Netflix la serie basada en el 'caso Daniel Sancho': la plataforma confirma quién será el actor protagonista

en.title: Netflix series based on 'Daniel Sancho case' arrives: platform confirms lead actor
en.summary: Netflix announced a miniseries inspired by the Daniel Sancho case, with actor Martiño Rivas in the lead role. The case involves a chef convicted of murder in Thailand.

stories.title: EEUU sanciona a la Corte Penal Internacional después de que Trump se sumara a los ataques contra la ex juez que ha ganado el Nobel de la Paz

en.title: USA sanctions International Criminal Court after Trump joins attacks against former judge who won Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: The United States imposed sanctions on the International Criminal Court following Trump's criticism of a former judge. The Nobel Committee awarded the Peace Prize to this judge despite the attacks.

stories.title: La Fiscalía pide al Supremo que no revise el censo de la 'ley de nietos' para las elecciones del 29-N

en.title: Prosecution asks Supreme Court not to review census of 'grandchildren law' for November 29 elections
en.summary: The prosecution requested that Spain's Supreme Court not revise the electoral census related to the 'grandchildren law' ahead of upcoming elections. The court had previously suspended registration under this law.

stories.title: La jurista sudafricana Navi Pillay, Premio Nobel de la Paz 2026

en.title: South African jurist Navi Pillay, 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: The Norwegian Committee awarded the Nobel Peace Prize to South African jurist Navi Pillay for her efforts in promoting peace, international law, and supporting victims of violence and conflict.

stories.title: Navi Pillay, la Nobel de la Paz que acusó a Israel de cometer un genocidio en Gaza

en.title: Navi Pillay, the Nobel Peace Prize winner who accused Israel of committing genocide in Gaza
en.summary: South African jurist Navi Pillay, aged 85, received the Nobel Peace Prize for her lifelong work against apartheid, Rwandan massacres, and persecution of Rohingya people in Myanmar.

stories.title: South African lawyer Navi Pillay awarded 2026 Nobel Peace Prize

en.title: South African lawyer Navi Pillay awarded 2026 Nobel Peace Prize
en.summary: The Norwegian Nobel committee recognized South African lawyer Navi Pillay's efforts to promote peace and international law while bringing hope to victims of violence and conflict.

stories.title: El PSOE explora listas conjuntas de izquierdas frente a la mayoría del PP en el Senado

en.title: PSOE explores joint left-wing lists against PP majority in Senate
en.summary: Spanish Socialist party leadership is open to forming combined left-wing electoral lists for Senate elections, prioritizing Madrid despite difficulties in negotiations between groups and the tight timeframe of the November 29 election call.

stories.title: Feijóo acepta dos debates electorales con Sánchez, incluido un cara a cara, y a TVE le concede sólo una entrevista

en.title: Feijóo accepts two electoral debates with Sánchez, including a head-to-head, and grants TVE only one interview
en.summary: The PP leader agreed to two debates with the prime minister, proposing November 16 for the main confrontation, while limiting his appearance on public broadcaster TVE to a single interview.

stories.title: El Ibex recupera los 19.000 puntos y reduce la caída semanal al 0,3%

en.title: Ibex recovers 19,000 points and reduces weekly decline to 0.3%
en.summary: The Spanish Ibex stock index rebounded to recover 19,000 points on positive market sentiment, as Trump's decision against military action on Iran eased oil prices and debt interest rates.

stories.title: La UE sella un acuerdo descafeinado de megasupervisión de los mercados

en.title: The EU seals a watered-down mega-supervision agreement for markets
en.summary: The EU reached an agreement on market supervision where ESMA gained authority, but Germany modified criteria to exclude Deutsche Börse from joint oversight. Spain's BME will continue under national supervision.

stories.title: El primer tren bala de India tropieza con las desavenencias con su socio japonés

en.title: India's first bullet train faces setbacks due to disagreements with Japanese partner
en.summary: India's high-speed rail project has experienced delays, cost overruns, and tensions between India and its Japanese partner.

stories.title: ¿Cómo afectará el adelanto electoral al Ibex-35? con Antonio Castelo de IBroker

en.title: How will the early election affect the Ibex-35?
en.summary: Spain's early election call has created uncertainty among investors regarding the potential impact on Spanish stock markets and government formation.

stories.title: Las compañías de cruceros rebajan sus precios en el Caribe

en.title: Cruise companies reduce prices in the Caribbean
en.summary: Cruise operators, led by Norwegian, are cutting Caribbean prices due to vessel redirects from the Middle East, creating excess capacity and intensifying competition for passengers.
